resources.string: Wi-Fi Direct · Dev server (root)

Requires root and Android Auto developer setup. On Open Headunit select Headunit Server → Auto and enable automatic Wi-Fi Direct. This mode manages the server, including one started manually. Reconnect is automatic; Stop or 5 seconds without the selected Bluetooth devices shuts it down.

Android Auto 17.4+ blocks the legacy Wireless Helper trigger. On a rooted phone use Wi-Fi Direct · Dev server (root), with Headunit Server → Auto and automatic Wi-Fi Direct on Open Headunit. Without root, start the headunit server manually in Android Auto settings or use a supported Native connection.
